content.title: Could Invivyd's (IVVD) Expanding Antibody Pipeline Redefine Its Long-Term Therapeutic Strategy?
content.summary: Invivyd recently announced that the SPEAR Study Group has issued a consensus recommendation for a clinical study to evaluate the effects of its monoclonal antibody therapy, VYD2311, on Long COVID, utilizing the same antibody backbone as its previously EUA-granted product, pemivibart. This development highlights the ongoing expansion of Invivyd’s antibody pipeline beyond COVID-19 prophylaxis, with clinical momentum targeting emerging needs such as Long COVID.
